top_signals.summary: A rig collapsed in Miami’s financial district near the construction site of Citadel’s new headquarters, crushing several cars and snarling traffic, according to reports.

top_signals.title: Uniper to Sell Gas Pipeline Stake to Meet EU State Aid Conditions
top_signals.summary: Uniper announced on Monday an agreement to sell its 20% stake in the OPAL gas pipeline as part of the EU’s conditions on state aid that allowed Germany to bail out the German energy giant in 2022. Back then, the German government stepped in to nationalize Uniper to avoid its collapse amid soaring gas prices, with the total bill for the nationalization at about $53 billion.
